column1: # Black Ops 4's own Magmagat sounds (tools/import_sounds.pl reads them from BO4's zm_escape / zm_common banks into the
# mod.all bank of mod.ff). Read from the running game: each row is one variant of a BO4 alias (zm_escape's
# ww_blundergat_fire_t8 / _upgraded fire, dry fire and the weapon script's blob, burst and burning sounds), with its
# file, the alias it layers (BO4's secondary alias, played with it), its volume (BO4's linear gain as T6's
# 100 + 20 log10) and distances. A file is its name in the bank, or #<id> when the name is unknown.
# Not taken: the burst's frag shockwave layers (volume 0 in BO4).
